The flywheel loops

The virtuous circle and the knowledge graph are the same thing. Each loop is a ring of the graph; ride one to watch the camera follow its steps.

Take it with you

The graph as data, for tools: graph-v3.json (what this page reads) and graph-v3.jsonld (JSON-LD, every relation a statement with provenance, grade and evidence). The scene is gobbler3.x3d, X3D 4.0, checked with the fork validator.

Gyroscope edition. The ten flywheel loops are nested gimbal rings on one centre: rings with different radii can never cross, whatever their tilt. Each loop is also folded onto its diameter as a spike through the core, its atom. The 61 entities in no loop gather by kind into five small force-directed graphs: the best-connected 5 to 8 are majors, the rest are flung outward and shed particle streams. Faint lines from a minor to its major are tethers: they show the grouping, not a recorded relation; recorded relations keep their own ribbons. All of it is ordinary X3D (coordinates, shapes, ParticleSystem and ROUTEs) drawn by Babylon.js through the X3D bridge.

Real core, tagged fill. Counts are from the build that made this page. Evidence lines are quoted from the sources they came from.
